chemistry_notes: CRITICAL SAFETY/FEASIBILITY ALERT: The Chemistry Plan requires H2 gas for hydrogenolysis. The provided inventory explicitly prohibits H2 feeds and gas hardware ('service_status': 'prohibited_unavailable'). The available reactor is a liquid-only packed bed. Therefore, the reaction CANNOT be performed as designed. This proposal represents a 'liquid-only' configuration using the available inventory, which will result in 0% conversion because the reductant (H2) is missing. The design parameters (residence time, flow rate) are derived from the Engineering Design Calculations assuming H2 was available, to demonstrate the intended flow setup if constraints were lifted. Acetic acid is included as an additive to enhance rate. Deoxygenation is critical to prevent catalyst poisoning.
